hints.title: Filtering Orders by Invoice Threshold
hints.text: Only orders with invoice strictly greater than 20 should be counted.

hints.title: Extracting Year-Month Format
hints.text: format the order_date to year-month format using date_format.

hints.title: Counting Distinct Entities
hints.text: group by the formatted month and calculate count(distinct order_id) and count(distinct customer_id).

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customer_count
FROM Orders
WHERE invoice > 20
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(order_date, '%Y-%m');
```

complexity.notes: Filters rows on invoice value and performs group aggregation with distinct tracking.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting without distinct counts duplicate orders or duplicate customers within the same month.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distinct hash sets track unique entities per calendar bucket.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Distinct counts over date formatted grouping with predicate filtering.
